description: This file contains unit tests for the TailscaleIntegrationSection view in a SwiftUI application. It tests different states of the Tailscale service such as not installed, serve mode, and funnel mode, by creating instances of TailscaleService with various parameters and verifying the view's body rendering.

classes.name: TailscaleIntegrationSectionTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests for the TailscaleIntegrationSection SwiftUI view, testing different states based on the TailscaleService configuration.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body when not installed`
methods.description: Tests the view rendering when the Tailscale service is not installed and not running.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body for serve mode`
methods.description: Tests the view rendering when the Tailscale service is installed, running, and in serve mode.

methods.name: `tailscale section builds body for funnel mode`
methods.description: Tests the view rendering when the Tailscale service is installed, not running, and in funnel mode.
